Gina and Jon met/spoke on 20 Jan 2023 at 4:04 pm (D1). Both had recently lost jobs—Jon his banking job the day before; Gina her Door Dash job earlier that month. Jon planned to launch a dance studio from a lifelong passion; both love dance, especially contemporary, and bonded over its expressiveness/stress relief. They agreed to meet for a dance session “next Friday” (27 Jan 2023). Jon shared a suit-dancing competition photo from a crew that won first last year and said he wanted to share that intensity. Gina used to compete; her favorite memory was her team winning first at regionals at 15 with an emotional contemporary piece, “Finding Freedom.” They also shared photos of a couple standing together and a large open porch with fireplace/water view.

Later D1, Jon described his ideal studio: a room by the ocean with yoga mats. Gina admired it and asked about rehearsal time given his business plans; Jon hoped they’d find such a place to inspire them. Gina asked what dances/projects he practiced. Jon rehearsed after work with a small group, contemporary to hip-hop, finishing choreography to perform at a nearby festival next month. He shared a photo of dancers in white dresses onstage; Gina called them graceful and looked forward to the festival.

On 29 Jan 2023 2:32 pm (D2), Gina said things were hectic: she had launched an ad campaign for her clothing store and shared a store photo. Starting her own store/taking risks felt scary and rewarding. Jon congratulated her, saying the store looked great and her hard work paid off. Gina asked about the studio/right spot. Jon was still hunting, picturing spaces, and had found a place with great natural light; he had been to Paris “yesterday” (28 Jan) and shared a photo of a bathroom with blue floor/pink wall. Gina admired it, asked location/features, and said Paris sounded great—she’d never visited, only Rome once. Jon said the place was downtown/easy to reach with natural light, but he still needed to check size/floor quality. They discussed a good dance floor with bounce for safety/enjoyment; Jon wanted Marley flooring (grippy yet allowing movement, tough, easy to clean). Gina agreed Marley was perfect and said she couldn’t wait to see his studio done. Jon said the process was exciting/nerve-wracking but he was determined and believed it would be worth it. Gina encouraged him to believe in himself, push through, take breaks, and “dance it out” to destress. Jon was glad to have her in his corner; they agreed to make time to dance/vent. Mutual support: Jon said success was almost here and “We got this!”

On 1 Feb 2023 12:48 am (D3), Jon said he was still following his dance passion; it had been bumpy but he remained determined and still searching for a studio place. Gina was happy/inspired. She had emailed wholesalers and one replied “yes” that day; she was over the moon to expand her store/get closer to customers, and shared a photo of a shopping mall glass entrance/sign. Jon congratulated her on the perfect spot/hard work; he shared a photo of a room with mirror/wooden floor. Gina thanked him and shared a peek at her designed space: a cozy, inviting clothing store for trendy pieces. Jon asked about furniture/decor choices. Gina wanted it to reflect her style/make customers cozy; she chose furniture that looks great/is comfortable, and a chandelier for glam. Jon said the store looked great/customers would be comfortable. Gina said comfortable/inviting was key—she wanted customers to feel in a “cool oasis” and create an experience making them return. Jon agreed special experience was key and believed she could create the space. Gina thanked him; his support meant a lot, and hard work could make a special shopping experience, though it was tough she was up for the challenge. Jon always supported her and urged her to create something awesome. Gina encouraged his studio, saying keep going/stay positive, “We’ll get through this!” Jon thanked her; her words meant a lot, he was staying positive/pushing forward, and was sure that since they’d put their hearts into their dreams they’d make it. Gina said “Sure thing, Jon!” and encouraged him to stay motivated/keep going, saying hard work pays off and “We can do this!”

On 4 Feb 2023 10:43 am (D4:1–19), Jon greeted Gina, asked about the store, and said he had something to tell her about his business. Gina said the store was great/“a wild ride” and asked about his business. Jon was putting in lots of work despite obstacles and was determined. Gina praised his drive, saying he’d “make a splash.” Jon thanked her; it was hard when things didn’t go his way, but he was sure pushing would reach his dreams. Gina said setbacks were opportunities for comebacks; he had skills/passion/drive plus her support, and should not give up, “buddy.” Jon said with her support he could handle anything and appreciated her having his back. Gina said she was there no matter what and asked if he wanted to say anything about his business. Jon said searching for a studio location was tricky but he was determined to find the right spot; the rest would follow. Gina said it was tough and encouraged him to hang in/find it soon. Jon thanked her, said he was working on his business/new dance routines, and rehearsing hard for an upcoming show; dancing brought joy/fulfillment. He shared a photo of a woman in a gray dress doing a trick. Gina called him talented and asked about the show. Jon was preparing for a dance competition near him next month—a chance to show skills and get props from the dance community; he was “super stoked.” Gina said he’d “kill it,” his hard work/talent would pay off, and wished him luck. Jon thanked her, said her help meant a lot, and promised to do his best to make her proud. Gina said “no doubt,” his passion/commitment were awesome, and told him to keep it up. Jon said he was “going for my dreams!” Gina said she’d always cheer him on, told him to make his dreams happen/keep going/believe in himself, and “You got this!” D4:19 Jon thanked her again, said her kind words meant a lot, and promised, “I won’t give up!”

On 8 Feb 2023 9:32 am (D5:1–13), Gina greeted Jon, asked how he’d been, and said she’d found a cool new fashion piece for her store/couldn’t wait to share it with customers; she shared a photo of women posing with a giant balloon. Jon congratulated her, saying the store was growing. He recalled the festival performance: it was awesome and many people complimented his dance moves; dancing brought joy/reminded him of his passion. He shared a photo of young girls in a dance studio. Gina said it looked great and he looked “badass on stage,” then asked his favorite part of running his own studio. Jon loved the freedom to create a space and help dancers of all ages/levels express themselves; he was thrilled to dance each day and see students progress, which was fulfilling. Gina said that was awesome/amazing what dance can do. She had been working hard on her online store and teamed up with a local artist for cool designs; she shared a photo of a rack of clothes with a coat/dress. Jon praised her commitment/creativity and asked how she came up with the designs. Gina got the idea from a fashion magazine, saw there wasn’t much like it around, and worked with the artist to make it happen—being ahead of the game/giving customers something different. Jon said she never shied from a challenge and her risk-taking was inspiring. Gina agreed taking risks was scary but the only way to grow/part of the journey to success. Jon agreed risk was key; it made him grow and got him out of his secure 9–5 banking job. He was now aiming to turn his passion into a business.

On 16 March 2023 at 2:35 pm (D6:11–19), Jon thanked Gina for asking, saying losing his job was hard but he was “livin’ my dreams now.” Starting his business had been tough but he was “gonna make it”; he kept facing new challenges and was sure it would be worth it in the end. He shared a photo of a laptop computer on a table. Gina agreed that starting/running her own business had ups and downs but had been “an amazing ride!” Jon called it a rollercoaster and said Gina’s success inspired him to keep pushing; he praised her determination. Gina thanked him, said his words were encouraging, and was glad her journey inspired others. Jon said they face the same challenges, motivating each other “like having a partner to dance with.” Gina agreed they were on different paths but it was nice to have someone to root for them: “We can do it!” Jon said having someone back them up was great and suggested they keep going/reach success together. Gina said they should keep chasing dreams, supporting each other, and celebrating achievements: “We can do great things together!” Jon thanked her for having his back and toasted to “taking on new heights, and all the trials that come with it. Cheers!” He shared a photo of two glasses of champagne with a bottle of wine in the background.

On 23 March 2023 at 7:28 pm (D7:1–12), Jon greeted Gina. Gina said her online clothing store had been a roller coaster but rewarding, said starting a business takes courage, and told him to hang in too. Jon thanked her, said it had been tough but he was “gonna make it happen,” and praised her store. Gina thanked him, said the store was going good and she was keeping up with fashion trends to offer the best pieces; it was a lot of work but enjoyable. She asked for advice/tips on running a successful business. Jon advised strong brand identity, building customer relationships, showing customers he cares, staying positive, and motivating others because “Your energy will be contagious!” Gina thanked him, said she was always working on relationships/brand image, agreed positivity was key, and asked what motivated him with the dance studio. Jon said seeing students succeed motivated him; it was awesome to help them learn/reach goals. He said Gina’s support meant a lot and shared a photo of a group.

Maria and John are supportive friends and a self-described team, bonded over volunteering, family, community service, education, infrastructure, fitness, faith, and John’s political/military-service aspirations. They encourage each other and believe small actions can create big community change.

**17 Dec 2022:** Reconnected after a long time. John had returned from a family road trip; Maria had volunteered at a homeless shelter and done aerial yoga. John does kickboxing/taekwondo for fitness and de-stressing. He hopes to enter local politics, focusing on education and infrastructure because lacks of both affected his neighborhood growing up; he wants future generations to have properly funded schools and infrastructure. He shared a photo of men repairing a school after funding. His next step was talking with local leaders and organizations; Maria encouraged him and asked to be kept posted.

**22 Dec 2022:** Maria donated her old car to the homeless shelter and asked about John’s campaign. John had been networking and had just talked to someone whose stories fired his passion for improving education. He stressed investing in future generations as the foundation of progress and opportunity. Maria agreed minor tweaks can make a big difference and said she was impressed. John shared a family picnic photo, saying family is why he never gives up and their love gives him strength. Maria praised his supportive family. John called family his rock and shared a swing-ride photo. Maria asked about playground activities; John said climbing, sliding, and games. He asked what Maria enjoys with family; she said her family is small but she loves time with friends—movies, hiking, game nights—and quality connections matter most. They discussed shared meals building bonds. John said they made pizza and picked toppings; Maria recently made peach cobbler. John then left for taekwondo.

**1 Jan 2023:** John had joined a service-focused online group the previous week, calling it an emotional ride. Members were incredible with inspiring stories; it opened his eyes to new perspectives and gave connection and purpose. He shared a photo of a man on a bed using a laptop. Maria was supportive. John said sharing stories, advice, and encouragement with people who share his passion was inspiring. Maria asked if he had met members in person and shared a Santa poster photo. John said they had held events: visiting a homeless shelter with food and supplies and organizing a toy drive for kids in need; seeing the community come together was amazing. Maria asked about future projects. John said they were brainstorming ways to help underserved communities access education, mentorship, job training, and resume building to empower aspirations. Maria said education and mentorship are crucial and looked forward to initiatives. John believed the right assistance and resources can make lasting impact. Maria encouraged him. John thanked her and said her support meant a lot, especially since he had recently failed a military aptitude test and felt stressed. Maria reassured him she had his back, then shared a sunset-over-ocean photo from the beach last month; nature reminds her to slow down and appreciate small moments. John called it chill and said it reminded him of his childhood film camera and beach photos. Maria was glad. John agreed nature helps remember small joys and shared a photo of a group standing around a field.

**9 Jan 2023:** Maria told John she was now friends with a fellow volunteer who also loves helping others, and asked how he had been. John said he had been busy with work and family, but last week had an unexpected incident on his way home; he shared a photo of a car with a broken windshield. Maria was glad he was alright and shared a tattoo with a quote. John said it reminded him to stay strong; he tried to stay calm and asked for assistance, which helped him get home safely. Maria praised his resilience and resourcefulness and asked how he felt afterward; John felt relieved and grateful. Maria asked what he does to calm down; John said he likes looking at sunsets because they remind him to enjoy small things. Maria asked about his political goals. John said he had been looking into local politics, talking to community leaders, and learning neighborhood needs and hopes; it was informative and he felt optimistic. Maria praised his dedication and shared a notebook/pencil photo, saying she had been taking notes about local politics. John thanked her and said she was super helpful and gave him new ideas/plans. Maria asked what was next; John said next week he had a community meeting to discuss education and infrastructure upgrades. Maria wished him luck and hoped his ideas would be heard, sharing a microphone/chargers photo. John thanked her and said he would stick up for the community. Maria said talking and working together would make a difference, and his speaking out was admirable and inspiring. John thanked her and said, “Let’s make some change in our community!” Maria agreed they could bring positive changes as a team. John said joining forces would achieve great things and shared a handshake photo. Maria agreed unity is essential for tackling problems and building a great community. John thanked her for being an awesome friend; Maria said it was nice to help and they make a great team. John replied, “Yup, we rock as a team! Glad to have you.”

**28 Jan 2023:** John attended the community meeting. Hearing everyone’s worries made him realize upgrades are crucial, especially for kids. He was upset about the state of education and asked how they could improve it. Maria suggested fighting for more money and resources for schools and raising awareness about education’s importance. John agreed kids deserve better and noted his children have so much while others lack necessities; they need to do something. Maria shared that she had volunteered at a shelter during a kids’ event; she posted a photo of three women in green aprons holding pots and cups. John praised the impact and asked what made her get involved. Maria said she started volunteering to make a difference; her aunt believed in volunteering and used to help her family when they struggled, so Maria is inspired by her. Maria recalled her most impactful moment: noticing an 8-year-old girl sitting alone and looking sad because she had no other family; Maria sat with her, talked, comforted her, and they ended up laughing. John called it touching and shared a photo of a little girl kissing a doll. Maria asked about it. John said it reminded him of a childhood doll that made him feel better and reminds him to look out for others, especially when they feel down. Maria said spreading kindness and support can make a difference. John agreed a kind gesture can make a big difference. Maria agreed kindness is key and compassion can turn someone’s day around; she was glad they were on the same page.

**5 Feb 2023:** Maria said it had been a long time since they talked. She had challenged herself with a charity event last Friday; it was great, and she felt the power of collective effort to help people in need, calling it heartwarming. John praised her as inspiring, said it was cool to see the community make a difference, and asked how it felt; he shared a photo of a woman handing a plate of food to a man. Maria said serving meals and seeing gratitude was rewarding and reminded her how powerful compassion can be. She asked what made John get into politics. John said he feels a strong urge to serve his country and community, and running for office was his chance to make an impact. He asked about her charity event and whether something special made it meaningful. Maria said she spoke with a man named David; hearing his story of hardship and how he ended up in difficult circumstances was humbling and showed her everyone has their own story and deserves understanding. John agreed and asked if she knew organizations or services that could help David. Maria said she talked to David afterward and linked him with a nearby organization offering housing and support for homeless individuals, hoping he gets the help he needs. John praised her impact and asked if she had ever needed help. Maria said when she was younger her family had money problems and relied on outside help from her auntie; it was a tough learning experience about helping others who struggle. John said people learn from their own struggles and that he had just started helping with a food drive for people who lost their jobs; he shared a photo of himself at the food bank. Maria called it incredible and asked what inspired him. John said seeing the effect unemployment has on neighbors made him decide to act; he wanted to help in tough times through a community food drive and believes everyone can make a difference. Maria asked what sparked the initiative; John said unemployment in the community was the reason.

**6 Mar 2023:** John said his children were doing great.

**4 May 2023:** John and Maria discussed personal growth. John said it helps us grow and learn more about ourselves and that it is great to push limits and see what we can do. Maria agreed pushing boundaries is how we grow and discover what we are capable of; it is a hard but worthwhile journey of self-exploration, and she feels blessed they both have this mindset. John agreed it is a never-ending journey of learning and growth and said their right attitude helps them take on harder things and keep improving.

**6 May 2023:** John said a lot had happened since they last spoke. Last week he decided to run for office again, despite not being successful before; he cannot let go of his dream to make a difference in his community and feels like it is a dream come true. He shared a photo of a poster on a bulletin board with a man smiling.

**3 July 2023:** Maria shared that shelter resident Laura wrote a letter expressing gratitude; the impact they made on her life was inspiring.

**Conversation Summary**

Nate and Joanna reconnected **21 Jan 2022**. Nate likes **video games/movies** (esp. **action/sci-fi**), plays **CS:GO**, keeps pets. Joanna likes **writing, reading, movies, nature**; prefers **dramas/romcoms**; is **lactose intolerant**. Her stuffed dog from Nate, **Tilly**, stays with her while she writes and helps her focus/joy.

**Joanna — writing/acting:** Finished first full screenplay **23 Jan 2022** (drama/romance); planned festival submissions, anxious by **7 Feb**. **25 Feb** began second about a **30-year-old woman’s self-discovery after loss**, inspired by personal experience—**loss/identity**, healing road trip—wrapped **18 Mar**. **21 Apr** joined **writers group** (inspirational/supportive/motivating), working on **“Finding Home”** (girl finding true home). **Acting was her first passion**, but writing now helps her express herself; may return. **20 May** finished third screenplay—personal, about **loss/identity/connection**—hard but rewarding; writes best when vulnerable/true. **14 Aug** reconnected after a gap, busy writing—highs/lows; journal “my rock”; shared **sticker-covered notebook**. Shared a **handwritten letter** from someone who read her online blog post about a hard moment; her story brought comfort and reminded her why she loves writing; Nate said she was changing lives. **22 Aug** relaxing/recharging with **long walk/reading**; learned **breaks/self-care** matter for inspiration/mental health; **balance** key. Was nervous sharing her book with writers group but got **great feedback** and celebrated with dessert. **14 Sep 2022** **laptop crashed**; lost all work, nothing recoverable; now uses **external drive for backups**. **6 Oct 2022** finished writing her book after late nights/edits; proud/excited. Made a **cute bookmark for a lady at writing club**; loves **DIYs**. **21 Oct** had been revising/perfecting a family recipe that turned out tasty. Also **21 Oct** had **another production-company rejection** (film-contest submission); discouraged but wouldn’t let it slow her down, would keep grinding. Nate said rejections don’t define her, praised her resilience, and reminded her people are cheering; she thanked him and said she’d keep believing in herself. **25 Oct** shared that **another movie script she contributed to screened on the big screen last Sunday for the first time**—surreal, emotional, satisfying, long-awaited; it was the **third time**. Favorite part: seeing her characters/dialogue acted out and “jump off the page.” Shared **drawing book of character visuals** that help bring characters alive; ideas come from people she knows, things she’s seen, imagination. Nate praised drawings and asked about character on left. Later **25 Oct**, Joanna playfully refused to reveal movie details—“watch the movie and find out!” Nate said he already planned to watch it, and talking to her made him want to even more. She asked what he’d been up to. **4 Nov 2022:** Joanna set up meetings with **movie producers**—“my dreams are comin’ true!” Meetings went really well; she felt confident discussing her script/vision; producers seemed interested/excited and loved the **self-discovery** elements; validating to be taken seriously; hopeful/inspired. Nate praised her bravery, compared recognition to winning a video game tournament, said he was proud. Joanna thanked him; writing isn’t always easy but moments like these make her appreciate it; thankful for opportunities. Last week found **old notebooks with early writings**; cool to see how far she’s come; shared image of notebook with list of things to write. Favorite early piece: story from age 10 about a **brave little turtle** who was scared but explored the world anyway; maybe even then inspired by **courage/taking risks**; still part of her writing today. Nate noted her passion and found the turtle theme funny; said turtles’ **resilience** is inspiring; encouraged courage and pushing herself. Joanna said turtles make her think **strength/perseverance**; they motivate her in tough times; glad he finds that inspiring.

**Nate — pets:** Has **turtles/tortoises** (~3 years), calming, low-maintenance, personality. Joanna finds them adorable but is **severely allergic to most reptiles, furry animals, and cockroaches**, so likely won’t keep pets. **20 May** adopted **Max**, energetic dog bringing joy and keeping other pets active. **25 May** met nearby couple with dog; arranged **doggy playdates**. **22 Aug** shared “little dudes” in **new fish tank**; Joanna noted more room. Nate called them **“little buddies,” always calm/peaceful**; coming home after gaming is better because of them; **tank expansion** made them happy. Planned **weekend off to chill with pets**. **5 Sep** shared **two turtles on a rock in a pond** photo; hanging with them helped recently. **21 Oct** stressed about tournament progress/tough competitors, but turtles cheer him up; watching them walk makes him happy. **25 Oct** was bored, so took his turtles out for a walk; shared a photo of **two turtles on a log in a pond**. Joanna asked if they had fun; Nate said they looked tired and were relaxing in the tank. They eat **vegetables, fruits, and insects**—a varied diet. His favorite is watching them eat **fruit**: they get hyped and it’s cute; shared a strawberries/turtle photo. He also likes **holding them**; shared a turtle-in-hand photo. Joanna found them cute and asked whether turtles have different personalities like dogs/cats. Nate confirmed they each do: **one is more adventurous, one more reserved**, which he finds cute; having them brings joy and great companionship. He’s always liked turtles **since boyhood** and knows all about them. Joanna said she never knew turtles could be so interesting until meeting his; asked him to keep her posted. Signed off “See you later Joanna!”

**Nate — gaming/social:** Won first **CS:GO tournament** before reconnecting. **2 May** shared **gaming room** photo; won **second tournament** previous week; usually **CS:GO**, but tried **local Street Fighter tournament** and was really good. Winning felt **super awesome**, adrenaline. **21 Apr** had **gaming tournament next month**, his **4th**. **22 Aug** won **international tournament** previous day; gaming brought success and could make a living from passion. Joanna congratulated him, proud. **5 Sep** had **letdown in video game tourney**—didn’t do great despite trying; called it **setback**, stayed positive, learning curve. **14 Sep** taught **vegan ice cream recipes on his own cooking show** last Monday; nerve-wracking but a blast; picked up recipes. **6 Oct 2022** won **really big video game tournament last week**; awesome, made **so much money**; shared **trophy/controller** photo. Saved some, unsure what to do; **completely content already**, no big plans; extra cash nice. Joanna said it brings **freedom/relaxation**; Nate said he finally doesn’t have to stress and can enjoy movies/games. **9 Oct 2022** went to **game convention last Friday**; met new people outside normal circle; overwhelming but reminded him of good times gaming can bring. Joanna said fun/rewarding; encouraged stepping outside comfort zones. Later **9 Oct**, Nate made friends who love games like him and planned **gaming session**; also joined people playing a **board game he loves** and hit it off. They played **Catan**, strategy game about building settlements/trading resources. Joanna asked competitive/chill; Nate said both—competed but had fun. Gaming is his **escape from life struggles**, so he doesn’t get crazy competitive; convention people same. Joanna encouraged him. Nate suggested a **writing convention**; Joanna wasn’t sure they existed, said she’d look into it. That evening Nate was **chilling at home**, playing games/watching movies; shared **bookcase of DVDs/movies** photo. Saw **“Inception”**—mind-blowing twists/dream stuff; playing **“Cyberpunk 2077”** nonstop for futuristic setting/gameplay. Joanna watched a **classic movie** with gripping story/great actors; shared **framed movie poster with signed picture**; rated **9 or 10/10**, saying movies take us places and make us feel emotions. Nate agreed movies take him to new worlds and are great for chilling. Joanna agreed they’re a great escape, “especially when you have a room like this!”; shared **living room with TV/candles** photo. **6 Oct** signed off “Bye for now!” **9 Oct** Nate admired her cozy living room and asked for pointers. Joanna advised **large, fluffy, multi-person couch**, **slightly weighted blanket**, **dimmable lights**. Nate thanked her, would try; Joanna said she gets invested in little things that make life nicer. Signed off “See ya Nate!” **21 Oct** Nate said he’d been practicing for his next video game tournament. **4 Nov** Nate praised Joanna’s producer meetings and shared an image of a TV screen showing a game being played; compared her recognition to winning a video game tournament. Ended by asking what she’d been up to.

**Food/desserts:** Nate discovered **coconut milk ice cream**; likes **coconut milk, chocolate, mixed berry** dairy-free flavors; made **dairy-free chocolate cake with berries** and **chocolate-vanilla swirl** ice cream for a friend. **17 Apr** shared recipe—**coconut milk, vanilla, sugar, pinch salt**; chill, churn, freeze until scoopable. Joanna planned to try. She made **dairy-free vanilla cake with strawberry filling and coconut cream frosting**; cooking/baking are creative outlets. **14 Aug** Nate began **teaching people dairy-free desserts**, fun/rewarding; sent a creamy dairy-free recipe. Joanna planned to surprise family and keep him posted. **5 Sep** Joanna shared **cake with strawberries/chocolate** photo; revised old recipe; tinkering for comfort/creativity. Experimenting with **chocolate, raspberry, coconut**; uses **coconut/almond milk** due lactose; fun challenge making treats for everyone’s diets. Made **dairy-free chocolate coconut cupcakes with raspberry frosting*

**Conversation Summary**  
*Updated through 26 December 2023*

- **Key people:** John — Minnesota Wolves shooting guard; Tim — fantasy-literature fan, student, online magazine writer, learning violin.

- **John:** Joined Wolves May 2023; focused on shooting/fitting team style. Loves sneaker collecting and basketball jerseys. Basketball central since childhood: watched NBA with dad, local league at 10, school, college scholarship, drafted. Goals: championship, charity, inspiring others, meaningful legacy. Works with local org helping disadvantaged kids via sports/school. Values teammates as “second family”; autographed team basketball symbolizes bond. Nike basketball shoe/gear deal; was in Gatorade talks; likes Under Armour; thinks about endorsements, brand-building, life after basketball. Career-high 40 points in July; hit last basket in tight August win; looked forward to Seattle game; loves ocean/surfing (started five years ago). Large bookshelf; loved **The Alchemist**; enjoys non-fiction on personal development/mindset. Married girlfriend in intimate greenhouse ceremony late Sept 2023 with safety protocols; favorite memories: bride walking down aisle, first dance at cozy candlelit restaurant; some new hiking-club friends attended. Favorite team Wolves; favorite player **LeBron James**, whose skills, leadership, work ethic, dedication inspire him. Met LeBron a few times—“real chill,” “wild”—and seen him live; tough but taught him a lot. Oct 2023: season intense, tough losses/great wins, team did well; tough opponents drive improvement, they back each other up, won’t quit, won a trophy; hard work worth it, felt elated. **17 Oct:** off-season mentoring younger players—rewarding way to share skills/knowledge/stay involved; challenges because everyone is different, but enjoys adapting, motivating/encouraging, watching each develop. Some see him as mentor; gives advice/support on/off court, enjoys positive role model role, values trust/admiration, glad experiences can shape futures/inspire dreams. **21 Oct:** whiteboard has motivational quotes/strategies for focus/tough workouts; physical reminders help. Desk plaque: believe in himself/trust abilities; lightbox: “make it happen.” Teammates believing in him and love of improving keep him going; doesn’t want to let them down; they support him despite mistakes. Outside sports has supportive people/family; team like second family. Enjoys movies/dinner with friends/family; cooking therapeutic/creative—often honey garlic chicken with roasted vegetables, enjoys new recipes.

- **Tim/John interactions:** **6 Nov 2023:** Tim wished John/wife great trip and recommended castles (“just so magical”); John said they’d check some out. **11 Nov:** John said he and wife took amazing European coastline road trip—spectacular views, fun bonding/memories. Shared photo of group atop mountain. Tim shared book/statue images and noted nature can leave us speechless and makes us realize how huge/special the world is. John said nature is powerful, beautiful, humbling. John had just finished an amazing fantasy series—wild ride, many twists—praising storylines/characters; loves getting lost in fantasy worlds. Tim agreed, called fantasy an escape, mentioned “That” as a favorite fantasy show; John had seen it and said amazing to see worlds/characters come alive. They discussed books/movies as mental breaks that let the mind wander/refresh; Tim said breaks recharge, bring peace, reconnect us with ourselves, give perspective. John agreed taking time for oneself is crucial for staying sharp/focused and tackling challenges with energy; balance is key. Tim said balance varies and encouraged John to care for himself mentally/physically—“You got this, bud!”—John thanked him, said support means a lot, and would keep pushing.

- **Injury arc:** **16 Nov 2023:** Tim visited a castle during UK trip—unbelievable architecture/history—and posted photo of castle with river. John said really cool but tough week with injury; shared photo of bandaged leg, stayed positive. Tim said “Ouch, bummer,” hoped he’d hang tight; Tim’s week swamped with exams but plowing through. John asked about exam prep/confidence. Tim said exams challenging but best effort/optimistic/diligent; asked how John stays motivated during difficult study sessions. John visualizes goals/success for focus/motivation; asked Tim for study tricks. Tim breaks studying into 25-minute blocks with 5-minute fun breaks—less overwhelming/keeps on track. John praised it, wished him best; Tim thanked him, hoped injury healed soon. John said “Got your back,” doctor said not too serious. John hates not being on court; Tim compared it to being unable to read due to injury. John pushing on; Tim told him take care/keep pushing. **21 Nov:** Tim checked in hoping injury better. John thanked him, said tough but staying positive/taking it slow, asked how Tim had been. Tim swamped with studies/projects but had setback: tried writing story based on UK experiences, didn’t go as wanted; asked John advice on improving storytelling. John advised reflecting on what went wrong/finding ways to improve, as after court challenges. Tim liked idea, asked John’s toughest basketball challenge. John said last season hurt ankle, needed time off/physical therapy, frustrated not playing/helping team; stayed focused on recovery/strengthening body. Tough mentally/physically but taught patience/perseverance; grateful to overcome. Tim praised resilience. John said difficult times are part of life; what matters is how we handle them; remembering passion/love for basketball motivates him. Tim said writing/reading motivate him, asked if similar happened in basketball. John recalled messing up in a big game, hard to accept; instead of getting stuck, worked to improve. Taught resilience/owning up to mistakes; wants to keep growing as player/teammate. Tim called it awesome; admitting mistakes/using them to improve shows how much John cares. John thanked him, said it’s about growing on/off court; Tim agreed, “We got this!” and shared photo of books as “companions on my growth journey.” They discussed favorites: Harry Potter and Game of Thrones still Tim’s; John loves personal-development/mindset non-fiction; Tim also likes growth/psychology/self-improvement. John recently reread **“The Alchemist”**—inspiring; made him think about following dreams/personal legends; Tim said it changed his perspective on goals too. Both agreed books open new worlds, inspire, help us grow, and said they’d keep exploring books/motivating each other.

- **1 Dec 2023:** Tim returned after “ages”: tough exam previous week had him doubting himself, but instead of giving up he turned it into a learning experience. John shared photo of campfire with chairs and stayed supportive.

- **6 Dec 2023:** Tim said he is learning violin, mostly classical but keen to try jazz/film scores; great way to chill/get creative.

- **16 Dec 2023:** John said jogging without pain after being out so long was a huge success; he and his wife hosted a small get-together.

- **19 Dec 2023:** John thanked Tim, said “Let’s keep at it and continue supporting each other,” and appreciated Tim’s assistance. Tim replied that they should support each other, said “I’m here for you,” urged John to keep believing in himself, and said bye.

- **26 Dec 2023:** John said his week had been busy: he started doing seminars helping people with sports and marketing, and it had been awesome. Photos showed a basketball court with a crowd and a man and woman onstage at a convention. Tim congratulated him and asked how it went. John said the seminars went really well; aspiring professionals were eager and motivated, and he was happy to share knowledge/help out. Tim said he was starting big new things too and shared a photo of a golden-covered book. Tim explained he had been reading travelers’ stories from around the world and using them to plan his next adventure; the book contained many such stories. He had read about two hikers who trekked through the Himalayas—tough but worth it, with challenging terrain, altitude sickness, and bad weather, but they made it and saw amazing sights; it motivated Tim. John called it cool, asked if Tim had read any stories, and said he was looking for travel ideas too. Tim said he had visited a travel agency to learn requirements for his next dream trip. John said challenges help us learn and grow, called it fun, and asked to be kept updated. Tim said he would and told John to keep pushing for his goals; he shared a photo of a newspaper article with a picture of a woman.

**Rolling summary — through 19 Oct 2023 (S24, D24:21).**

**People/context.** Audrey: dog lover; four 3-year-old mutts—Pepper, Precious, Panda, Pixie (two Jack Russell mixes, two Chihuahua mixes); dog tattoos representing love for pups/nature; loves nature, cooking, garlic, Mediterranean flavors, positive-reinforcement training. Family Chicken Pot Pie recipe from grandma; Roasted Chicken favorite comfort meal. She makes jewelry from recycled objects (bottle caps, buttons, broken jewelry), sells it, and donates part of profits to an animal shelter. Andrew: Financial Analyst; loves nature/hiking/eagles/birdwatching; girlfriend; adopted German Shepherd Toby on 11 Jul 2023 and second shelter dog Buddy by 19 Oct 2023; novice cook; sought dog-friendly rental near parks/woods; tried rock climbing; interested in kayaking/bungee jumping; recently fishing. Both treat pets as family; nature/dogs bring joy, peace, and reset.

**S1–S17 (Mar–Aug 2023).** Audrey and Andrew bonded over dogs/nature. Andrew wanted a dog but found city dog-friendly housing hard; Audrey suggested filters/landlord outreach. They discussed nature as home/reset/therapeutic; shared bakery/nature photos and planned a pastry party. Audrey saw a hummingbird; Andrew hiked weekly and wanted parks/woods nearby. Audrey had a lucky park and road-tripped to a national park every couple months with dogs; Andrew added a dog road trip to his bucket list. Audrey took a positive-reinforcement pet bonding workshop; dogs learn quickly via rewards and punishment is never proper; Andrew agreed/planned classes. Audrey described a national-park sunset hike with dogs as a “slice of paradise”; Andrew was discouraged but determined about housing. Andrew took a rock-climbing class, got hooked, planned weekly outdoor activity; interested in kayaking/bungee jumping. Audrey found a small park/tree-lined trail and invited him; he accepted. Audrey walks dogs about an hour, letting them explore. Agreed nature/dogs bring joy, peace, and reset.

Audrey moved to a bigger backyard with a doggy play area/agility equipment. Andrew shared a doggy daycare and offered help finding dog places. Agreed pets are family; Audrey dislikes people who hurt pets. Andrew shared park flowers; hiked, loved birds/trees, missed nature; did urban adventures. Audrey’s dog-training course was challenging but rewarding; dogs improved. Andrew asked about breeds; Audrey described her mutts/pack and their love of running/fetch. Cooking de-stresses Andrew; he’s a rookie. Audrey loves cooking; shared Chicken Pot Pie grandma recipe, garlic as go-to ingredient, and Roasted Chicken Mediterranean comfort meal; promised recipes; Andrew planned to try/report back. Andrew had a picnic with his girlfriend; Audrey said her dogs make her happy. Andrew wished for a dog but housing/right dog was tough; asked how she got hers. Audrey cited a lucky nearby breeder and that dog-friendly places are hard. Andrew found leashed parks but not open run areas; Audrey suggested a hike with dogs; Andrew agreed for next month, stressed trail safety; shared trail photo/map. Andrew was excited to meet her dogs; Audrey shared a leashed-dogs photo; both said the dogs’ joy is contagious. Audrey shared a prior 3-hour-drive mountain sunset; Andrew asked where; she didn’t name it but praised vibrant/peaceful nature moments. Andrew adopted Toby on 11 Jul—“a bundle of joy”; planned a nature-reserve weekend; Audrey advised bond-building takes time. Andrew shared Toby’s leashed photo, said he loves Toby; Audrey called Toby cute/happy and predicted adventures.

**S18–S19 (6–24 Sep 2023).** Andrew said work was tough/stressful; outdoor activities took a backseat and balance was hard. Audrey advised daily self-care/fun; Andrew agreed morning coffee/lunch walks help. Audrey organized a doggy playdate and shared a photo; bought new beds for cooler weather; dogs snuggle “like they’re in a cloud.” Andrew said animals find joy in simple things. Audrey: dogs bring love/happiness; “They are everything to me.”

**S20 (1 Oct 2023).** Andrew announced a beach trip next month with his girlfriend and Toby; shared an ocean-sunset photo. Audrey was excited and can’t wait for their hike with the dogs; said nature relaxes/clears her mind. She shared dogs on a grassy field at the nearby dog park last Saturday—big grassy area with shaded spots; dogs loved it. Andrew missed that experience and was excited for the hike; said nature is refreshing compared with the city hustle. Audrey agreed it feels “like being a bird flying free.” Birdwatching: Andrew loves birds’ grace/freedom; Audrey wants to try it, finds it peaceful/calming. Andrew offered advice and suggested a group birdwatching trip; Audrey accepted, is using a guidebook, and shared a binoculars/book photo. Andrew said he’ll bring binoculars/notebook/camera to log birds; shared a photo. Andrew enjoys birdwatching and reads books about ecological systems. Audrey asked what he’s learned; he began saying he learned a lot about animals. Later Audrey asked Andrew to show her the best bike routes by the river; he agreed, said there are many routes around the area, and will show the best ones; both were excited to get outside and soak up the scenery.

**S21 (4 Oct 2023).** Andrew said it had been a while. Audrey said it’s been a wild ride and that she took her pups to the beach over the weekend—they played/swam in the ocean and had a blast. Andrew shared a beach/surfboard photo and asked if they loved the water. He hasn’t been to the beach lately, misses being outdoors, and says open spaces are hard to find in the city. He used to hike a lot, but work-life balance is challenging; nature was his escape/peace, and he feels a void. Audrey sympathized and suggested bringing nature into the city with plants at home and weekend park trips. Andrew agreed he should get more plants, said they can bring peace, thanked her, and will reach out for help/advice. Audrey offered anytime; Andrew thanked her again, asked her to say hi to the dogs, and signed off; Audrey said she would and “talk later”; Andrew wished her a great week. Audrey replied “Have a great week! Bye!”

**S22 (6 Oct 2023).** Audrey reflected on Andrew missing nature and shared that a knee injury had temporarily stopped her dog walks; it was tough because the dogs bring her so much joy. After she recovered and resumed walking, she shared a photo of two dogs running in a field with a ball. Andrew sympathized, said the dogs must have been overjoyed, and noted dogs remind people to appreciate simple pleasures. Audrey agreed they see the world differently. Andrew recalled Audrey’s jewelry hobby—making pieces from recycled objects—and asked for more. Audrey explained she uses bottle caps, buttons, and broken jewelry to create one-of-a-kind pieces, combining creativity and sustainability and reducing waste; shared a photo of herself wearing a colorful necklace/earrings. She started as a hobby, now sells jewelry, and donates a portion of profits to an animal shelter close to her heart; customers support the cause. Andrew praised the necklace/design and asked whether she sells/donates and to which organization. Audrey said any hobby can have an impact when used right; she donates to an animal shelter doing great work. Andrew called her dedication inspiring, noting she can’t volunteer at the shelter anymore. Audrey said she’s still finding ways to do good and life is about adapting/helping out; Andrew agreed life is about rolling with the punches and making a difference, and praised her hard work. Audrey thanked him and said she’ll stay strong and keep making a difference even in challenging times.

**S23 (13 Oct 2023).** Andrew said it had been a busy week; last Tuesday his girlfriend, Toby, and he had an awesome night playing board games—really nice. He shared a photo of a dog sitting at a chess board. Audrey said she’d made cookies to thank her neighbors for their pup-friendly homes, a nice way to bring joy; shared a photo of cookies on a wooden table. She asked about weekend plans. Andrew said Friday night’s board game session was a nice break; this weekend he plans to check out a cozy cafe and hang out, sharing a photo of people at a table. Audrey said the cafe looked cozy and asked for other recommendations. Andrew shared a photo of a man on a couch in a large open space for a new spot that just opened, saying it has an awesome view and vibe. Audrey said it looked great and asked, “Can I bring my pups with me?” Andrew replied he wasn’t sure if the spot was suitable for dogs, but there’s a great dog park close by and suggested bringing their coffee over. Audrey agreed—exploring new places is always an adventure for her dogs—and shared a photo of a dog in a sweater sitting in grass. Andrew called the dog sweet in the sweater and asked if they enjoy the dog park. Audrey said the dog park is “like paradise” for them: they love socializing with other pups, getting exercise, running around, and smelling everything; she asked for funny stories about Toby at the dog park and shared a photo of two dogs playing with a frisbee in a field. Andrew told a story about Toby getting too excited and chasing a squirrel around a tree while the squirrel watched from the branches; he shared a dog-with-frisbee photo. Audrey laughed, asked Toby’s breed, and said her dogs love running at the park but hate snow—last winter they were confused in a snowy park and clearly prefer sunny days in the grass; she shared a photo of a dog in a shirt standing on a hardwood floor. Andrew said Toby is a German Shepherd who loves cute sweaters and is very active, then asked what games Audrey’s dogs like to play at the park. Audrey said her dogs go crazy for Fetch and Frisbee, love to run around and meet other pups, and could keep running for hours. Rolling summary: John and James are supportive online/gaming friends with shared interests in gaming, programming, pets, travel, reading, nature, cooking, music, and helping others; they encourage each other.

S1 (17 Mar 2022): John shared a medical chart/procedure and enjoyed combining passions. James suggested John’s HTML skills could help their game; they agreed teamwork would be great. James bowls; John dislikes bowling. They discussed slots/arcades; James once got engrossed and had his wallet taken. John proposed VR; both wanted to try it together.

S2 (20 Mar 2022): James made an avatar, joined a new platform, and felt part of a gaming community. They agreed gaming creates bonds and is a refuge from stress. John bought a metal detector and found bottle caps, coins, and once a gold ring. James shared his two dogs, calling them his best buds/joy; they know sit, stay, paw, rollover, and Daisy waits for treats. John wanted a pet someday; James offered to help find one.

S3 (27 Mar 2022): John shared a big game win and confidence boost. James is learning drums; John also plays drums. James got a cutting-edge gaming system and plays to relax/connect. John attended a gaming convention, tried games, met developers, joined a CS:GO tournament, and found it intense/inspiring. James encouraged learning from experienced gamers and sets small goals/tracks progress. James was getting into RPGs/strategy games; John encouraged exploring genres.

S4 (4 Apr 2022): James joined an online gaming tournament, made the semis, found finals tough, but had a blast. He met the team; one gave tips and autographs. Advice: communicate with the team and never put ego above team success. James uses voice chat and likes Apex Legends for intensity, graphics, and fast pace.

S5 (12 Apr 2022): James adopted a shelter pup in Stamford named Ned. John’s work was busy, so less gaming, but gaming still helps him forget stress. John was playing a new RPG with a futuristic-dystopia story/world but some lag/errors. James preferred waiting for bug fixes; John urged him to try now and offered a link. James agreed and would report back.

S6 (20 Apr 2022): John met three cool new friends in his programming course. James worked with a gaming pal on a programming project creating a virtual world inspired by Witcher 3; he shared a screenshot of his created character. Inspiration came from a stranger woman he saw while walking his dogs two weeks earlier; he didn’t approach her but embodied her appearance in the game. John shared a calming canyon/river/mountain photo found nearby two days earlier. John follows “only those who rest well work well”; chilling with friends and traveling motivate him. James loves travel and has visited Italy, Turkey, and Mexico. John has visited Japan and loves its megacities, technology, building screens, and street food. James suggested they travel somewhere together next year; John hoped it works out. James said he’d start looking for a country; John asked to be kept posted and offered help.

S7 (23 Apr 2022): James took his dogs on a hike, explored trails, enjoyed greenery/fresh air, and shared a wooded-path photo. Nature helps him clear his head. John’s work was hectic with deadlines; a difficult coding project left him stuck/frustrated trying to improve a new algorithm. James suggested breaking it into smaller steps, researching similar algorithms, asking other programmers, and seeking help. John thanked him and said he wouldn’t quit. James encouraged: “You got this.”

S8 (29 Apr 2022): John took on freelance programming to hone his skills, starting with a website for a local small business—his first professional project outside class. Progress was slow with hiccups; website payments were tough, but he used resources and was getting closer. James encouraged him. James bought an adventure/fantasy book with cool art. John recommended “The Name of the Wind” trilogy; James said he’d check it out and shared a three-book set photo. James also shared Daisy lying on a bed next to him while he played a game.

S9 (4 May 2022): James said pets are loyal and bring joy. His happiness list: pets, computer games, travel, and pizza. James likes pepperoni, cheese, and prosciutto; John loves Hawaiian pizza and sweet-and-salty flavors. John hadn’t tried prosciutto but said he would.

S10 (8 May 2022): John organized a CS:GO tournament with friends; many attended and they raised money for charity. James said it must have taken effort but sounded worth it.

S12 (23 May 2022): John took second place in a local tournament last Friday.

S17 (22 Jul 2022): John complimented a photo as amazing; James said he was tired over the last two days and had to go. They said bye/take care.

S18 (6 Aug 2022): John and James caught up after a while. John recently left his IT job after 3 years—scary at first, but he wanted work aligned with his values/passions and is happy/loving his new job. James called it brave and said he was proud. John is drawn to the gaming industry and wants to become a state-level tournament organizer for various computer games, including CS:GO and Fortnite. He already made connections and plans to gain experience and perfect his skills. James supported him and offered financial assistance or advice if needed. John asked what was new. James said he took his puppy to the clinic yesterday for a routine examination and vaccination against seasonal canine disease; the puppy is okay. John was relieved and praised James’s pet care. James replied that his dogs are the source of his joy, so he will always take care of them. John called James a great host; they said bye/take care.

S19 (10 Aug 2022): John said the recent conversation made him think about his passions/goals and thanked James for encouraging him to try new game genres. John has been playing strategy and RPG games instead of his usual shooters and is already thinking about making competitions for them too. He is hooked on “The Witcher 3,” praising its storytelling, characters, monster hunter, choices that shape the world, and immersion. James agreed Witcher 3 is amazing, especially player choices/impact and graphics, and shared an image of a man in armor holding a sword. John shared his organized gaming workspace with computer and chair; James admired the wall lighting. James said he took his three dogs to a beach outing to have fun and bond with other dogkeepers. John said he surely gained a new experience communicating with other dog lovers. James met a beautiful girl, Samantha, who gave him her phone number; he planned to call her tomorrow. John encouraged him and hoped he’d have a wonderful time.

S20 (21 Aug 2022): John joined an online programming group last Friday; it has been incredible. He values the community of people with similar goals—coding and making a difference. The group has skilled, passionate coders using tech for good; they share ideas, chat about coding, and work on projects together. John exchanged contacts with a few. He collaborated last week with a group member; their complementary strengths helped create something awesome, and he enjoyed teamwork. James said it was great networking and asked about collaborations. John clarified this is not a return to programming—it was a one-time experience to learn something new and work as a team. He remains determined to start hosting eSports competitions. John asked if James participates in online groups. James said no online groups, but he has a regular gaming group; they stream sessions and recently had a fun get-together. John said it’s great James has friends to game with, then shared that he bought new devices and refurbished his gaming desk. James asked about his gear and described his own setup: gaming PC, keyboard, mouse, comfy chair. John has a similar gaming chair and keyboard, plus a gaming PC with a powerful graphics card and an immersive-sound headset. He said gaming is an escape that keeps him focused and motivated elsewhere. James agreed; he hosted an all-night gaming marathon with friends that strengthened their bond. John recalled his siblings throwing him a gaming marathon when he was younger; they stayed up all night and bonded. James asked if John still plays with his siblings. John said they don’t hang out much because they live far apart, but when they do they plan a gaming night. John is organizing one with his siblings next month and is excited. James wished him a great time. They said it was nice catching up and signed off with “take it easy,” “have fun,” and “talk soon.”

S21 (26 Aug 2022): James shared a photo of himself holding his dog on the couch; the dog came to him while he was playing on the console. John called the pup cute and asked his name. John said he has been helping his younger siblings with programming since they joined the programming course, and it’s cool seeing them get into it. James confirmed his dog’s name is Ned, said Ned has been awesome since he adopted him, can’t imagine life without him, and was glad John’s siblings signed up for programming. John said, “That’s right, his name is Ned, how could I forget?!” James asked whether John is already working on anything cool with his siblings. John said they are working together on a coding project: a simple text-based adventure game that helps them learn coding while having fun; he is proud and hopes they may create their own video games. James called it impressive. James said he has been trying different game genres and is dying to create a strategy game like Civilization, loving how complicated and in-depth they are; he hopes to make his own awesome strategy game one day. John said that’s impressive and he can’t wait to see it. James asked if John was free tomorrow; John said tomorrow is his day off and asked for suggestions. James suggested plans.

S24 (18 Sep 2022): John complimented a sketch and asked whether it related to music or James’s castle dream. James said music is a big part of his life.

Rolling summary — Deborah (“Deb”), a yoga teacher/community builder, and Jolene, an electrical/robotics engineering student. They bond over loss, yoga/meditation, nature, personal goals, relationships, travel, gaming, and mutual encouragement.

Session_1 — 23 Jan 2023: Pleasantries; Jolene finished an electrical engineering project. Deborah visited her late mother’s old house; they bonded over photos/loss. Deborah feels connected at her mom’s window bench. Jolene’s heart-shaped bird pendant from her mother (Paris, 2010) symbolizes freedom/goals; Deborah also has a pendant reminding her of her mother. Deborah’s goal: keep teaching yoga and supporting her community, helping people find peace/joy; yoga helped her through a rough time.

Session_2 — 27 Jan 2023: Deborah’s father died ~25 Jan; family shell-shocked. She finds peace via family time, memories, and the family album; shared her parents’ 1993 wedding photo. Deborah and her husband try to be as good a family as her parents; love/openness keep them close. Shared a thank-you letter from her yoga group. Her living-room yoga practice is in her old home, for her mom; the window seat gives peace/mother’s presence. Her mother loved reading/travel; Deborah shared an airplane-window sky photo. Jolene showed snake Susie; snakes calm her. Second snake Seraphim escaped while she gamed and coiled next to her; bought in Paris a year ago. Jolene/partner love gaming (“Detroit”); planned “Walking Dead” next Saturday.

Session_3 — 1 Feb 2023: Jolene busy with a huge robotics project for her engineering professor—tough but fun, creative/problem-solving; now enjoys design/programming and seeing the robot come together. Deborah praised her; met new neighbor Anna at park yoga yesterday; discussed yoga improving lives/community. Deborah asked if Jolene might resume yoga; Jolene mentioned console plans with her partner; Deborah said good they have something together.

Session_4 — 4 Feb 2023: Jolene on an emotional rollercoaster but coping. Major milestone: planned/researched/designed/built a sustainable water purifier for a rural community; seeing clean water was surreal/satisfying, showing engineering can make a difference and giving purpose. Deborah praised her and asked career aspirations. Jolene wants an engineering career with positive community impact via sustainable solutions. Deborah encouraged following passions; when tough, breathe and remember why. Deborah teaches yoga, helps balance/reconnection; bonded with Anna and shared dance-pose photo. They tried dance poses incl. Warrior II (strength/focus). Deborah explained modified chair pose: sit on chair edge, feet planted, twist torso, hand on knee for support, stretch back/shoulders, hold breaths, switch sides; relaxes tense muscles. Jolene said it sounded hard. Jolene into “Sapiens”; two weeks earlier read “Avalanche” by Neal Stephenson in one sitting. Deborah: stories teach/motivate/bring people together. Jolene shared a story of someone succeeding despite challenges—belief/hard work make anything possible. Deborah called it powerful, reminded her of someone special’s grace/strength in hardship.

Session_6 — 22 Feb 2023: Jolene said memories give comfort/joy. Deborah agreed; shared last photo with Karlie from last summer’s hike—last one, great time, makes her smile. Jolene asked where else Deborah traveled. Deborah: Bali last year was a favorite—gorgeous, peaceful, great for yoga. Jolene asked if beach yoga is a thing and wanted to try; Deborah said waves/fresh air are wonderful. Jolene would give it a go; Deborah said enjoy and let her know.

Session_7 — 25 Feb 2023: Jolene balancing engineering school and her partner’s video games; setting aside time for yoga/meditation, giving calm. Deborah: taking a break is key; asked how practices help. Jolene: they saved her—chills out/gains perspective, feels alert/motivated. Deborah asked if her partner does yoga; Jolene: he sometimes joins, nice bonding/relaxing, brought them closer. Deborah asked how long married; Jolene: not married, together 3 years, taking it slow/loving the ride; his ring is decoration, not a wedding ring. Deborah: enjoy the journey; asked how they met. Jolene: met in engineering class in college, friends first, blossomed. Deborah asked if they still enjoy engineering projects together; Jolene yes, teaming up feels great, understand each other’s struggles, both love it. Deborah asked whether yoga/meditation helps stress; Jolene: when overwhelmed, takes a break/breathing/meditation, feels calmer/clearer, handles challenges easier. Deborah praised progress, told her keep it up. Jolene thanked her; support means a lot; will keep pushing/taking time for herself. Deborah always rooting; listen to heart/take care; shared bench/sunset photo as reminder to find peace in chaos. Jolene asked Deborah’s daily routine. Deborah: mornings meditate/yoga/teach classes; yesterday first morning jog in nearby park, will incorporate into daily routine; evenings with loved ones. Jolene asked why; Deborah: exercise key, feels connected to body. Jolene called it a healthy habit. Deborah: “Can’t pour from an empty cup”; self-care gives energy to help others; Jolene is worth it too. Jolene thanked Deb; words meant a lot.

Session_14 — 26 June 2023: Deborah glad Jolene’s project worked out. Jolene asked about Deborah’s retreat. Deborah showed a photo of three people in front of a large statue; tried tree pose; statue symbolizes peace/enlightenment. Jolene: gorgeous, would love to visit a retreat like that; ideal for peace/refreshment. Deborah: perfect for reflecting/getting centered. Jolene: could use chill time. Deborah: everyone needs peaceful time. Jolene left “Gotta run, have a nice day!”; Deborah “See you!” and shared a sunset lake/boat photo.

Session_15 — 9 July 2023: Deborah started a running group with Anna; awesome connecting with fitness-minded people. Jolene glad; trying to add workouts to studying schedule—tough but fun; asked about challenges. Deborah: having a blast; group helps/pushes each other, easier to stay motivated. Jolene: supportive group is super motivating; finding a team passionate about something makes a huge difference; thinking about her own journey. Deborah agreed people who cheer/advise make a difference; asked what finding supportive folks has been like for Jolene. Jolene: gaming tough lately, grateful her partner is also into it and helps her stay focused on their goals; many cute photos. Deborah asked what she likes best about gaming together. Jolene: tackle challenges/share experiences; always a blast when into the same game and achieve something tough; great bonding/closeness. Deborah: gaming strengthens relationships; asked favorite game together. Jolene: “It Takes Two”—fun, competitive team-strategy game, great bonding; asked Deborah what activities she likes with people. Deborah: running and yoga/meditation with others; connecting/community is great; loves organizing workshops/events for mindfulness/self-care—fun, relationship-building, mutual support/growth. Shared photo of group doing park yoga. Jolene: sounds like a great way to relax; asked what the workshops are about.

Session_20 — 21 Aug 2023: Jolene said she has been doing it for 3 years—a great escape from studying/work stress. Deborah: taking time to unwind is key and it seems right for her. Jolene: “really finding my zen again!” Deborah: “Keep it up!” Jolene thanked Deb for her support. Deborah wished her good luck and said stay in touch.

Session_21 — 24 Aug 2023: Deborah said a lot had happened; last week she went to a yoga retreat near her mom’s place—hung with nature, got to know herself, “life-changing”; shared a forest trail photo. Jolene was glad; nature is her own way to relax; asked Deborah’s thoughts on life. Deborah: life meaningful lately; nature/self-reflection help her see the beauty of every moment and grow by listening to herself; shared a mountain sunset photo; asked Jolene’s insights. Jolene: life hectic but making strides toward goals—tough but satisfying. Deborah asked for more. Jolene: goal is success in her field and positive impact; studying, workshops, networking; recently presented at a virtual conference and got positive feedback—great experience confirming she’s on the right track. Deborah asked how the positive feedback felt and what’s next. Jolene: thrilled/rewarding to know her efforts were appreciated; focusing on study/gaining experience; considering more internships to enhance skills; exciting times, hopes for more updates soon. Deborah proud, offered help, “Onward!” Jolene thanked her. Deborah: “You got this!” Jolene: not giving up, will keep pushing forward. Deborah: reach goals and enjoy the journey. Jolene thanked Deb; support means a lot; will keep pushing and enjoy every step. Deborah then: the journey is as important as the destination; take time for herself and find joy; “We believe in you!”; shared a sunflower field/sunset photo. Jolene agreed, will take the advice/find joy, cheered for the support; shared a city skyline at sunset/water photo. Deborah: “Always by your side!”

Session_22 — 26 Aug 2023: Deborah had been thinking about her mom’s influence; remembering loved ones is important. Jolene understood; last Friday she and her partner discussed how loved ones influenced them and what their values meant; emotional chat made them closer/showed what really matters. Deborah asked more about the values. Jolene: loved ones taught perseverance/resilience; her mom said never give up; partner’s dad modeled determination; values influenced their goals—Jolene’s engineering and partner’s creative endeavors; they feel values encouraging them despite challenges.

Session_23 — 30 Aug 2023, 11:46 am: Deborah: “Have a great day!”

Session_24 — 3 Sep 2023, 2:14 pm: Deborah went to a community meetup last Friday; shared stories and felt connected; an event last week aimed at mutual support was inspiring. Relationships with family/friends are vital.

Rolling summary: Sam and Evan are friends who support each other through health, fitness, hobbies, family, and life changes.

- **6 June 2023:** Evan had heart palpitations—a wake-up call—and cut processed/sugary foods despite loving ginger snaps. Sam shared a healthy salad but still liked soda/candy; Evan suggested flavored seltzer and dark chocolate. Sam agreed to try.
- **27 July 2023:** Sam was hurt by friends mocking his weight; Evan offered to work on health together, shared gym/produce photos, and said cutting sugary snacks and eating more veggies/fruit helped most. Sam was reducing soda/candy and asked for low-calorie snacks; Evan suggested seltzer, air-popped popcorn, and fruit. Evan mentioned reading “The Great Gatsby” (calling it a mystery); Sam said he might read it. Evan emphasized small healthy swaps and progress over perfection. Sam planned to start at the gym the next day.
- **7 August 2023:** Evan met an “awesome” Canadian woman and felt alive. Sam congratulated him; they discussed Evan’s health challenges. Evan said he’d prioritized health for ~2 years, family motivates him, a smartwatch helps track goals, and adventure/hikes motivate him. A bonsai symbolized strength and resilience. They agreed small things build resilience and consistency matters.
- **13 August 2023:** Evan returned from a Canada vacation with his new SO; they enjoyed hiking, biking, and outdoor exploration. Sam said his health had been hard and shared a motivating note: “Don't fear it, just take the first step... progress is more important than perfection.” Evan celebrated small wins and joked about losing his keys weekly. Sam described a soaring dream; Evan suggested a dream-interpretation book.
- **15 August 2023:** Evan’s son hurt his ankle in a soccer accident; Evan cared for him and took him to the doctor. Sam had a tough week and a doctor’s wake-up call; he was taking a cooking class for healthier meals and made grilled salmon with veggies.
- **27 August 2023:** Evan’s knee issue needed PT; he stayed low-key and swam to stay active. Sam said swimming is low-impact. Evan shared a Rocky Mountains road-trip photo and invited Sam to hike together; he recommended a lake about two hours away with trails. Sam hoped to road-trip and hike soon.
- **11 September 2023:** Evan shared a sunset painting; Sam shared a before-and-after body photo from his diet and wanted to motivate others. Sam was making healthier choices but still had cravings for sugary drinks/snacks triggered by stress, boredom, or comfort. Evan said painting or drives help him de-stress; he offered painting supplies and a session. They planned to paint the next Saturday.
- **6 October 2023:** Sam reconnected after a long time and said he’d started eating healthier.
- **5 December 2023:** Evan thanked Sam for his invaluable support; Sam said everyone needs help when trying new things. Evan agreed it helps not being alone. Sam asked to hear how the yoga goes; they said a warm goodbye.
- **9 December 2023:** Evan announced his partner is pregnant; he was excited and a bit nervous, noting it’s been a while since a toddler was around and recalling the joy of his first child’s birth. Sam congratulated him, said parenthood is amazing, and predicted he’ll be a great parent. Evan shared a collage of family memories—birthdays, holidays, vacations. The center sign is from a Banff trip and says “Bring it on Home,” the family motto about togetherness wherever they are. Sam found it touching and important for keeping family bonds strong. Evan said family is his rock and he looks forward to expanding it and making more memories. He and Sam discussed adding to the collage; Evan is planning a big family reunion next summer. Sam offered tips on organizing big events and support celebrating family milestones. They exchanged warm goodbyes, with Evan promising updates.
- **17 December 2023:** Evan reconnected, saying lots had happened. His son fell off his bike the previous Tuesday; it was rough, but he is doing better. Evan shared a photo of the boy with crutches and a backpack. Sam said he’d been through bumps and that after their earlier talks he’d been thinking about coping but found it challenging. Evan asked about happy hobbies; Sam said he used to love hiking but hadn’t had the chance lately. Evan recalled Sam mentioning hiking and suggested they plan a hike soon. Sam said he’s struggling with his weight and confidence, feels he can’t overcome the challenges, and keeps lacking motivation; he shared a beach photo. Evan said to believe in himself, take it one day at a time, and remember his worth isn’t defined by weight. Sam thanked him and said breaking out of his comfort zone is tough. Evan encouraged trying something new, even small, saying success brings accomplishment. Sam agreed to take his advice, noting trying new things can be difficult. Evan also shared a photo of a woman standing in front of a painting. Sam asked about the woman and painting; Evan said it was a contemporary figurative painting he finished a few days earlier, emphasizing emotional state through expressive brushwork and vibrant color, capturing a moment of introspection, and that he was very proud of it. The woman is a close friend who helped get the painting published in an exhibition.
- **26 December 2023:** Sam reconnected; Evan said life had been up and down but he had gotten married “last week.” He shared a photo of a bride and groom kissing in front of a tree. The bride is the Canadian woman he met earlier; Evan said he was in love with her at first sight and doesn’t know why they didn’t marry sooner. He believes in love at first sight—like time stopped and a spark lit inside him. Sam congratulated them and said finding that connection must feel liberating; Evan described love as bringing happiness and fulfillment, like a beautiful sunset. Sam said he wishes he could feel the same about love, but he has started enjoying morning runs as a way to clear his head. Evan encouraged him to keep trying new things and said he might find his own version of love in unexpected places. Evan shared a minimalist painting (white background with blue, orange, and black) made during a mix of emotions—sad, mad, and hopeful—and said art helps him recognize and handle feelings without words. He also shared a painting of a bird flying over it, created with joy and freedom; spontaneous strokes and bold colors reflect a playful, liberated mood and embracing the creative process without restraint. Sam praised his talent and creativity, then shared a painting from an exhibit he visited a few days earlier—a woman holding flowers in front of her face—that inspired him. Sam said he sketches occasionally but hasn’t created anything remarkable yet; he feels he’ll have something to show before long and finds Evan’s passion inspiring. Evan offered to help him get started if he ever wants to give painting a go. Evan also joked that he lost his keys again, a weekly ritual.
