Calvin and Dave met online. Calvin is a musician; Dave is an automotive engineer who owns a car maintenance shop (opened around 1 May 2023). Dave often calls Calvin “Cal.” They have not yet met in person but plan to meet in Boston.

Timeline:

- Mar–Apr 2023: Calvin was excited about a big life change and showed his “new mansion.” He was fascinated by Japanese culture and planned to leave next month, stay a few months, then go to Boston. His agent found cozy accommodation; he planned city exploration, local cuisines, and possible collaborations with local musicians. Dave recommended a calming park with a lake and boats. Calvin bought a red luxury sports car—smooth, powerful, an adrenaline rush. Dave attended a Boston music festival; Aerosmith was incredible and he finally saw them live, though he did not hang out with them afterward. Calvin had written new tunes and had studio sessions. Calvin attended a Tokyo music event, met artists/industry people, and got inspiring advice; a producer told him to stay true to himself and sound unique, making him think about his music’s direction. He dreamed of world touring/global connections/impact and looked forward to Boston after the Frank Ocean tour. Dave offered to show him around/cool spots (Paradise Rock, House of Blues, Fenway Park), promised front-row support, and shared a Boston skyline photo. Dave discussed a car show/classic-car restoration and shared a green Mustang photo. Calvin showed his red sports car at a show; he hadn’t explored Boston beyond gigs but looked forward to food/attractions and suggested grabbing a bite; Dave agreed to show favorite spots.
- 1 May 2023: Dave announced he had opened his own car maintenance shop—a dream come true—and shared photos. Calvin congratulated him/praised his ambition. Dave said the shop was a step toward classic cars; he loved their design/engineering and had restored one last year. They discussed the satisfaction of creating from scratch and bringing things back to life. Dave invited Calvin; Calvin said it looked great, would love to visit, and asked what cars Dave works on. Dave said all kinds, from regular maintenance to full classic restorations, and that helping people keep cars in good condition is rewarding. Calvin praised him for doing what he loves/helping others; Dave thanked “Cal” and said the validation meant a lot.
- 31 May 2023: Calvin said the experience was amazing and fans’ energy/love were crazy. He asked whether the car in Dave’s picture was the one whose engine Dave had been fixing for a friend and said working on cars helps him chill/clear his head. Dave confirmed “Yes, Cal!”, said helping neighbors/car work is therapeutic, and asked whether it relaxed Calvin. Calvin said yes—fixing cars calms him, gives achievement, and is like meditating—and asked about Dave’s hobbies. Dave said fixing things is more than a hobby, gives purpose, and he gets a buzz transforming something broken into something that runs smoothly, like giving it a second chance. Calvin compared it to creating/collaborating. Dave said giving something new life makes him feel powerful/happy/accomplished. Calvin said performing live fuels his soul and he loves the rush/crowd connection. Dave said the artist-audience connection must be powerful, shared a concert-crowd photo, and said music brings people together, creates atmosphere, and is like therapy. Calvin said everyone is part of it, “like one big harmony,” and shared another concert photo. Calvin couldn’t wait for the Frank tour, was buzzing to perform in Boston, and said playing for folks from home would be great; he asked Dave’s take on Boston’s music scene.
- 9 Jun 2023: Calvin thanked Dave for checking in, said he was stoked about his album, and that the team had been making “magic” in the studio. Dave praised the studio/teamwork, told him to keep pushing, and said he had been exploring parks on weekends to relax, finding nature peaceful; he asked about chill Boston spots. Calvin said he had never been to Boston, heard its parks were amazing, and couldn’t wait to visit next month; he shared a pink-flowering-tree photo and asked for cool Boston park memories. Dave said Boston parks are awesome, especially in spring, and weekend walks recharge him. Calvin was excited for that serenity/recharge, asked if Dave had hiked lately, and shared a mountain-path photo. Dave said he hadn’t hiked recently but finds nature/pushing to new heights awesome, mind-clearing, and calm; he asked if Calvin had been to the mountains. Calvin said no but was keen, wanted to escape/de-stress, and hoped to hike somewhere similar; he shared a plane-over-snowy-mountains photo and asked what was new. Dave said he had booked a trip to a mountainous region next month to see majestic peaks. Calvin told him to have a great time, take lots of pics, and show him when back; Dave agreed. They wished each other safe travels and said see you soon.
- 21 Jun 2023: Calvin said he’d had a little car accident last Friday—upsetting, but no one was hurt—and had been dealing with insurance/repairs. Dave was sorry, glad nobody was hurt, and asked whether Calvin had encountered issues. Calvin said the insurance process was a hassle—it took forever and involved lots of paperwork—but was sorted now and the car was being fixed; he couldn’t wait to drive again. Dave asked how long it took and said he was glad it was taken care of. Calvin said it only took a week; he had worried about the cost, but it wasn’t too bad. Dave asked about the mechanic; Calvin said he knows the stuff and is doing his best to get the car running.
